from tslearn.neighbors.neighbors import KNeighborsTimeSeriesMixin
import numpy as np

class CustomKNN(KNeighborsTimeSeriesMixin):
    def __init__(self, X_fit):
        self.n_neighbors = 1
        self.metric = "euclidean"
        self.metric_params = None
        self.n_jobs = 1
        self._X_fit = X_fit
        self._ts_fit = self._X_fit
        self._d = X_fit.shape[2]

# Use a subset of the preloaded balanced dataset for fitting
X_fit = X[:4]
knn = CustomKNN(X_fit)

# Query with a slice of the fitted data to expect exact matches (distance 0)
X_query = X[2:4]
dist, ind = knn.kneighbors(X_query, n_neighbors=1)

# Verify the shape and exact match indices
assert ind.shape == (2, 1), f"Expected indices shape (2, 1), got {ind.shape}"
assert dist.shape == (2, 1), f"Expected distances shape (2, 1), got {dist.shape}"
assert ind[0, 0] == 2, f"Expected nearest neighbor index 2, got {ind[0, 0]}"
assert ind[1, 0] == 3, f"Expected nearest neighbor index 3, got {ind[1, 0]}"

print(f"__CHECK__ KNeighborsTimeSeriesMixin computed nearest neighbor indices: {ind.flatten().tolist()}")
